title: Find equals direct lookup
statement: Let $\mathit{uf} \colon \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \bbn$ be a union-find state on $n$ nodes, and let $i$ be one of its nodes. Then the representative of $i$ returned by $\mathrm{find}$ coincides with the direct evaluation of the state at $i$; that is, $\mathrm{find}(\mathit{uf}, i) = \mathit{uf}(i)$.
replaced:
For any union-find state $\mathit{uf}$ and index $i$,
$\mathit{uf}.\mathtt{find}\,i = \mathit{uf}(i)$; this is the unfolding
simp-lemma for \texttt{find}.
